content.content: Plan: full-validate the Work Unit and source Intake, inspect current managers and contracts, then confirm the dedicated execution context before any side effect.
Work: write failing tests for both checkpoint phases, admission refusal and bypass paths, exact staging, replay, inspection, and validation-to-stage swaps.
Work: write interruption, same-attempt recovery, idempotent retry, retry exhaustion, blocking transition, blocker-resolution, and no-abandoned-working regression tests.
Work: implement checkpoint and inspection commands with argument-array Git execution, deterministic receipts, and safe failure cleanup.
Work: implement one package admission contract and enforce it before both worktree and execution-state mutation boundaries.
Work: implement versioned durable step checkpoints, resume ownership, stable idempotency identity, bounded transient retry, and evidence-backed blocking.
AI Review: inspect security, lifecycle state invariants, restart safety, replay behavior, scope, tests, and documentation consistency.
Report: register verification and review evidence and prepare the Korean Human checklist; leave approval, integration, cleanup, push, and PR decisions to the Human.
